LanguageData.LP_OozeEngulf.label: engulf
LanguageData.LP_OozeEngulf.description: Swallow a corpse whole into the body and digest it slowly; takes 2 hours and can be interrupted. The corpse disappears; clothes and weapons stay behind. Humanlike corpses: protoplasm +25, food +50%; animals: protoplasm = body size ×15 (up to 30), food = body size ×30% (up to 60%); halved for corpses that have started rotting. Desiccated corpses, mechanoids, liches and necromantic constructs, and oozefolk corpses can't be engulfed. Colonists who see it within 15 cells get mood -3 (1 day; cannibals, psychopaths and oozefolk don't care). Engulfing a humanlike corpse counts as eating human flesh. You can also select an oozefolk and right-click a corpse to order it.
LanguageData.LP_OozeFission.label: fission
LanguageData.LP_OozeFission.description: Split off part of your protoplasm, and an hour later an oozefolk baby is born: the same xenotype, carrying all the parent's endogenes (implanted xenogenes aren't copied), with random skin color. Only adult oozefolk can split; costs 80 protoplasm and 25% food; the parent then has 3 days of "fission weakness" (consciousness -20%, move speed ×80%). Cooldown 30 days (adjustable to 15-60 days in mod settings).
LanguageData.LP_OozeSeep.label: seep through
LanguageData.LP_OozeSeep.description: Squeeze through a door crack: pick a spot within 3 cells with a door between you (or click the door directly) and instantly seep to the other side. Any door works, locked or an enemy's alike; but you can't pass through walls or rock. Costs 10 protoplasm, cooldown 1 hour.
LanguageData.LP_OozeReshape.label: reshape
LanguageData.LP_OozeReshape.description: Rest still for 6 hours to sculpt missing body parts back out of protoplasm: restores one missing external part (hand, foot, finger, toe, ear, nose; not eyes or internal organs, bigger first); with no missing parts, smooths out one permanent scar instead. Costs 40 protoplasm, cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_OozeExtractGel.label: exude gel
LanguageData.LP_OozeExtractGel.description: Squeeze some protoplasm out of the body to congeal 1 protoplasm gel (used for gel dressings and stabilizing belts). Costs 25 protoplasm, takes 30 seconds.
